BiblicalUsage: Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in his house, and flourishing in his palace, when the dream came. The Aramaic word is to be at ease, to prosper quietly, and the verse is the calm before the tree is cut down.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rest without God is the most dangerous rest there is, for Nebuchadnezzar flourished in his palace while the dream was already on its way, and I hold that prosperity is no proof of God's favour.
